title: SAS-4 initiator link layer: OOB bring-up, 128b/130b-style blocks (sync header + scrambled payload), block lock and loss of sync, SOF / header / payload / CRC-32 / EOF frames, and a built-in write / read-verify sequencer over a 16 x 32-bit register file

fields.desc: OOB done and the link is up (cleared by a loss of sync, which restarts OOB)

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: CRC error, protocol violation (control block out of place, missing EOF, length above 8, bad register address, unknown type), sequencer timeout, read-verify mismatch, or loss of sync

notes: tx_p / tx_n (serial out, 1 bit per PCLK), rx_p / rx_n (serial in; only rx_p is sampled) and link_up pass through unchanged. The initiator runs on its own after reset and verifies its own traffic against a reflecting link partner.
The scrambler is simplified to x^16 + x^5 + 1 (SAS-4 uses x^58 + x^39 + 1).
